name: prompt-glimpse
description: Read-only pane showing the system prompt sections, context blocks and system reminders Claude is actually sent, with an optional on-disk debug log

debugLog.title: Write debug log
debugLog.description: Also write every system prompt version, context block and reminder to files on disk

showDiff.title: Show changes
showDiff.description: Keep each section's and context block's previous text, so a changed row can show what changed; also keeps rows that stopped being sent

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Where the debug log goes; empty means ~/.claude/prompt-glimpse-logs
